metric_definition: For each non-abstention question with labeled answer sources, compare retrieved Top-20 (source_session_id, source_pair_index) values against answer-bearing message pairs in the source dataset. This is a labeled retrieval relevance proxy, not a factual audit of every stored memory.
interpretation: The strict pair precision is a lower bound because LongMemEval labels only answer-bearing message pairs and may omit useful context. The source-session precision is broader but treats every pair in an answer-bearing session as relevant. Neither metric measures factual precision of all stored memory. The requested 100% stored-memory precision target remains unmeasured.
